# Generated README

This is a sample documentation file generated for integration testing.

## Overview

This document describes the automated documentation synchronisation workflow.

## Features

- Automatic change detection on every push to main
- Documentation generation from source templates
- Validation and secret scanning before publication
- Backup and rollback support
- Pull Request automation with review gating

## Usage

Trigger the workflow by pushing to `main` or via `workflow_dispatch`.
